title: Tuvima supporting files (Extras) rules
description: How Library finds supporting files beside a title and reads their owner, role and group from folder and file names (universal editor v5, sections 3b and D16). Documented for people on docs.tuvima.com as "Naming supporting files".

accepted_types.description: File extensions Library can open and so shows as a supporting file, by what opens them.

hidden_types.description: Files that are never supporting files: archives, metadata sidecars, subtitle files and artwork named for a media file (D16).

picture_sidecar_name_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression for picture names that are artwork (poster, fanart, thumb...), not supporting files.

ignored_folders.description: Folders other tools keep beside a title for their own use; never searched.

transient_files.description: Names of files that are still being written or are the system's own; never supporting files.

hint_folders.description: Folder names (whole name, any case) that hint the files inside are supporting files. They never change who a file belongs to.

group_parent_folders.description: Folders whose named sub-folders become groups (Extras/Character guides gives the group "Character guides").

folder_roles.description: Folder name (whole name, any case) to the role the files inside are guessed to have. A folder with a role is never a group.

role_words.description: Words in a file name that say what the file is. The first role whose word appears wins; a role the file's kind does not allow is skipped.

roles.description: The fixed list of roles a person can pick, by what the file is (document, clip, picture).

default_roles.description: The role a file gets when no name says otherwise. Must be in the kind's role list.

role_families.description: How supporting files are grouped by default on a title with many of them and no groups of its own.

document_hint_words.description: Words that say a document in a book or comic library is a companion, not a book or issue of its own.

clip_suffix_words.description: Words at the end of a video name that say it is an extra (Title-trailer.mkv, Season 1 trailer.mkv).

title_separators.description: Characters in a file name that read as spaces in the title.

missing_file_keep_days.description: How many days the record of a file that left the disk is kept, shown as "File missing".
